## Progress

- [PR #1440](https://github.com/ALFRED-LUCIFER/medvya/pull/1440): consent forms for extraction, root canal, implant and sedation in English, Hindi and Arabic; signed on the tablet (SignaturePad) with the signer's name; the signed form is a PDF in the document store with its hash and version; the item cannot start or finish without a current consent; a withdrawal (reason required) stops it
- Needs a person (AC3): a lawyer and a dentist approve the wording (DentalConsentRules.Approved is null and the screen and form say it is a draft)

## Description

Versioned consent templates per procedure (extraction, root canal, implant, sedation) in the patient's language; the patient signs on a tablet before the item starts; the signed form is stored as a document with its version.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** A plan item that needs consent cannot start until a signed consent of the current version exists.
- [ ] **AC2.** Withdrawal is recorded and stops later items.
- [ ] **AC3.** Wording is approved by a lawyer and a dentist before release.
